{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the revenue column for formatting
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].unique())

# Check if any contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)
print(f"\nRows with commas in revenue: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Display the shape and data types
df.info()"}
